title: Support hours
text: Human support is available Monday to Friday, 08:00 to 20:00 Eastern Time, and Saturday from 09:00 to 17:00. The virtual assistant is available 24/7. Voicemail left outside these hours is answered on the next business day.

title: Warranty coverage
text: Every device includes a 24-month limited warranty covering manufacturing defects. The warranty does not cover accidental damage or normal wear. Keep your order ID and proof of purchase; approved claims are repaired or replaced within ten business days.

title: Shipping times and costs
text: Standard shipping takes three to five business days and is free on orders over 50 dollars. Express shipping takes one to two business days and costs 12 dollars. Tracking is emailed as soon as the warehouse dispatches your parcel.

title: Accepted payment methods
text: We accept Visa, Mastercard, American Express, PayPal, Apple Pay and Google Pay. Enterprise customers can pay by invoice with net-30 terms after a credit check. We never store full card numbers on our servers.

title: Data security and privacy
text: All traffic is encrypted in transit with TLS 1.3 and data at rest is encrypted with AES-256. We are SOC 2 Type II certified and GDPR compliant. Personal data is retained for 24 months unless you request deletion. We do not sell customer data.

title: Integrations
text: Native integrations are available for Slack, Microsoft Teams, Salesforce, Zendesk and HubSpot. A REST API and signed webhooks cover custom systems. Most integrations connect through OAuth in under five minutes.

title: Supported languages
text: The assistant supports English, Spanish, French, German, Arabic and Japanese. Voice output uses locale-specific neural voices. Language is selected per session and can be changed by sending a new locale.

title: Company locations
text: Our headquarters is in Toronto, Canada, with engineering hubs in Austin and Berlin. The team is remote-first, so support is delivered across North American and European time zones.

title: Return policy
text: You may return an item within 30 days of delivery for a full refund. Items must be in original condition with all accessories. Refunds are issued to the original payment method within three to five business days after inspection. Final-sale items are not returnable.

title: Cancellation policy
text: Orders can be cancelled without charge until they are marked as shipped. Appointments can be cancelled or rescheduled up to 24 hours before the start time. Later cancellations may incur a 25 dollar fee.

title: Mobile app
text: The ConversaFlow app is available for iOS 16 and later and Android 12 and later. It supports push notifications, biometric login and offline access to your most recent conversations.

title: Exporting your data
text: Administrators can export conversations, analytics and knowledge documents as CSV or JSON from Settings, then Data. Large exports are prepared asynchronously and delivered as a signed download link valid for 24 hours.

title: Free trial
text: Every new workspace includes a 14-day free trial with up to five seats and 1,000 conversations. No credit card is required. At the end of the trial you can choose a paid plan or export your data.

title: Offline mode
text: The mobile app caches recent conversations for offline reading. New messages composed offline are queued and sent automatically when connectivity returns. The web app requires a network connection.

title: Seats and users
text: The Team plan includes 10 seats, the Business plan includes 50 seats, and the Enterprise plan is unlimited. Additional seats can be purchased at any time and are prorated for the current billing period.

title: Enterprise plan
text: The Enterprise plan adds a 99.9 percent uptime SLA, single sign-on with SAML or OIDC, audit logs, dedicated support and custom data residency. Volume pricing starts at 250 seats.

title: Single sign-on
text: Single sign-on is available on the Enterprise plan through SAML 2.0 or OpenID Connect. Administrators configure the identity provider in Settings, then Security, and can enforce SSO for every member of the workspace.

title: Subscription contents
text: A subscription includes the conversation runtime, the flow builder, knowledge base search, analytics and email support. Usage is billed monthly based on active seats and conversation volume. Annual billing receives a 15 percent discount.

title: Billing cycle and invoices
text: Subscriptions renew on the first day of each month. Invoices are issued at renewal and are available under Settings, Billing. Prices are shown in US dollars and exclude applicable taxes, which are calculated from your billing address.

title: Voice quality and barge-in
text: Voice sessions use low-latency streaming speech recognition and neural text-to-speech. Users can interrupt the bot at any time; the current prompt is cancelled and the new utterance takes priority. A transcript is retained for quality review.

title: Deleting your data
text: You can request deletion of your workspace data at any time. Verified requests are completed within 30 days, including backups. Some billing records are retained where required by law.
